titles.en: What Is Structured Concurrency? Python and JS in Practice

topics.angle: Explain the pattern (a parent task waits for all child tasks; an error in one child cancels its siblings and propagates predictably) versus unstructured fire-and-forget tasks, with concrete Python asyncio.TaskGroup and JS AbortController examples.
